section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 2000
title: 2.10 MEANS ADOPTED FOR COMMITTED SUICIDES 2.10.1 The means adopted for committing suicides varied from the easily available means such as consumption of poison, jumping into the well etc. to the more painful means such as self inflicted injuries, hanging, shooting. As in the past suicide by consuming Poison (38.2%), Hanging (26.1%) and Self Immolation (10.7%) were the prominent means of committing suicides. Table-2.10
